name: Cheesy Beef & Hash Brown Patties with Ranch Mixed Green Salad

instructions.primary_message: Place hash browns in a colander; rinse under hot water (from the tap) to thaw. Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the hash browns as you can.
instructions.secondary_message: 3 cups frozen shredded hash brown potatoes

instructions.primary_message: Place hash browns in a large bowl along with beef, cheese, eggs, salt, and pepper. Mix with your hands to combine, then form into 18 equal-sized patties and place on a large plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg lean ground beef
1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Mexican blend
3 eggs
1 ½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add patties and cook, undisturbed, until golden underneath, about 5 minutes; flip patties and cook an additional 5-6 minutes, until cooked through. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and halve grape tomatoes. Place in a clean large bowl.
Wash and dry the mixed greens (skip this step if they came pre-washed). Add to the bowl with the tomatoes, along with dressing, and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)
⅓ cup ranch dressing

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad and patties between plates. Drizzle patties with ketchup and enjoy!
